arStrings.szText:
Casting {c_important}Zealot{/c} Skills grants {c_important}{u}Fervor{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_1]{/c} seconds. Critically Striking with these Skills echoes the attack for an additional {c_number}[SF_2 * 100|%|]{/c} of the damage, repeating for each stack of {c_important}Fervor{/c}.

While at maximum {c_important}{u}Fervor{/u}{/c}, additionally {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:PAYLOAD_FORTIFY})|0|]){/c}.
